summary: OpenAI's CFO Sarah Friar introduces a framework, called an AI scorecard, for measuring AI return on investment through metrics like cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute.

practices.reason: The summary describes a proposed set of metrics for judging AI ROI, but gives no method or instrument an engineering team could apply.
practices.quote: introduces a practical AI scorecard to measure ROI through useful work, cost per successful task, dependability, and return on compute
